meta_title: KWS Heating & Plumbing | Gas Engineer Wolverhampton
meta_description: KWS Heating & Plumbing is a Gas Safe registered heating engineer in Wolverhampton. Fast boiler repairs, installations & maintenance. Call now for same-day service.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — 24/7 Emergency Callouts Available
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdown at 6am? KWS gets to you fast, diagnoses on the spot, and fixes most faults same day.
services_heading: Complete Heating & Plumbing Services Across Wolverhampton
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full system installations, we handle every heating and plumbing challenge in your home.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repairs
services.desc: Boiler packed up? We carry common parts on the van and aim to diagnose and fix most faults the same day. Available 24/7 for genuine emergencies.

services.title: Boiler Installations & Replacements
services.desc: New boiler fitted with a 10-year parts warranty. We handle all the paperwork and leave your system running safely and efficiently.

services.title: Central Heating Maintenance
services.desc: Annual boiler servicing keeps your system running smoothly, cuts fuel costs, and protects your warranty. We'll spot small problems before they become big ones.

services.title: Radiator & Pipe Work
services.desc: Leaking radiators, cold spots, or noisy pipes? We locate the fault, repair or replace, and flush the system to restore heat throughout your home.

services.title: Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Landlords and letting agents rely on us for fast, thorough Gas Safety Checks. We issue certificates on the same day and identify any hazards.

services.title: Power Flushing & Inhibitors
services.desc: Dirty pipework reduces heating efficiency and damages your boiler. Power flushing clears debris and a chemical inhibitor protects against future corrosion.

about_pullquote: I started KWS because I hated seeing customers ripped off by cowboys charging three times the fair price.
about_para_1: KWS Heating & Plumbing was founded 18 years ago in Wolverhampton with one goal: deliver honest, fast, and affordable heating repairs. Over nearly two decades, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, diagnosing problems correctly, and charging fair prices. Every engineer is Gas Safe registered and trained to the latest industry standards.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we answer the phone, arrive when we say we will, and explain what's wrong before we start work. We've completed over 2,400 jobs across Wolverhampton and the surrounding areas. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned boiler install, we treat your home with the same care we'd show our own.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About KWS

reviews.text: Boiler went down on a Sunday evening and I panicked. Called KWS at 6pm and they were here by 7:30. Dave diagnosed a faulty valve, replaced it, and we had heat again before bedtime. Fair price, professional, and genuinely helpful. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: Martin T.

reviews.text: Got a new Worcester boiler fitted last month. The lads were neat, efficient, and left the kitchen spotless. They walked me through the controls, sorted all the paperwork, and I've got a 10-year warranty. Highly recommend for any replacement work.
reviews.author: Christine L.

reviews.text: Needed a Gas Safety Certificate for my rental property. KWS came out, did a thorough check, issued the cert same day, and found a small issue I'd have missed. Professional and honest. That's rare.
reviews.author: Paul K.
